content:
═══ 角色 CHARACTER REFS（锁定形象，逐帧一致，不换脸不换装）═══

@ cass（女主）：Cassidy Marlowe，27岁，长款分层金发微卷、浅褐绿眼，

米色修身针织连衣裙、裸色细带高跟鞋、金链项链。气质本暖，此处转为锐利爆发。

@ marco（男主）：Marco Levine，42岁，深色卷发微秃额、黑框圆眼镜，

藏蓝修身西装外套+白衬衫+羊毛西裤+棕色皮鞋。本自信，此处转为窘迫狼狈。

═══ 场景 SCENE ═══

舞台剧现场——木质舞台、深色幕布背景，一束顶光打在两人身上，

台下观众席隐于黑暗（可见模糊人影与零星反光），剧场氛围，有现场张力。

═══ 剧情·分镜·英文台词（口型严格同步）═══

SHOT 1｜0–3秒｜中近景（女主正对男主）

@ cass 步步逼近 @ marco，下巴微抬、眼神锐利，连珠炮般质问，

每一句都带着上扬的问号、情绪层层加码：

〔@ cass，质问·递进〕"Danger? ... Danger?? ... DANGER???"

SHOT 2｜3–4.5秒｜半身（动作爆点）

话音未落，@ cass 反手一记舞台式耳光甩向 @ marco 脸侧（舞台表演·点到为止），

@ marco 头随之偏过去、眼镜微歪，全场一静。

〔啪 的一声响亮巴掌音效〕

SHOT 3｜4.5–6秒｜面部近景（女主）

@ cass 余怒未消，从齿缝挤出一声脏话：

〔@ cass，低吼〕"Fuck!"（或以一声"哔——"消音处理）

SHOT 4｜6–15秒｜中近景转面部特写（男主道歉）

@ marco 扶正眼镜、双手作揖姿态，神情诚惶诚恐、对着台下观众深深致歉，

语速诚恳、略带慌乱：

〔@ marco，诚恳道歉·英文〕

"I'm sorry. I'm so sorry, everyone.

My whole 'danger' theory caused you all so much trouble.

I'm a stupid pig. I sincerely apologize to all of you.

We'll do everything we can to get Fable 5 online as soon as possible."

说到最后微微鞠躬，灯光收拢在他身上。

═══ 声音设定 ═══

- @ cass：女声，由质问的锐利到爆发的怒，气声混怒音，节奏顿挫。

- @ marco：男声，诚恳、急切、略带颤抖的歉意，语速偏快。

- 全部英文台词与口型严格同步，发音清晰自然，不假唱不错位。

═══ 视觉·质感 ═══

写实真人电影质感，舞台顶光+边缘轮廓光，暖调，浅景深，

真实皮肤毛孔与微表情、布料物理、巴掌瞬间的头部惯性真实自然。

═══ 镜头 CAMERA ═══

舞台剧式机位：中近景／半身／面部特写切换，

巴掌瞬间快切+轻微镜头一震，道歉段缓慢推近，流畅不卡顿。

═══ CONSTRAINTS ═══

- 4K，横屏 16:9，约15秒，两角色与角色卡 100% 一致（不换脸不换装）

- 英文台词与口型严格同步；台词顺序与情绪严格按分镜

- 耳光为舞台表演·点到为止，头部惯性真实但无血无伤、不夸张暴力

- 写实真人质感，禁塑料假脸、禁过度磨皮、禁眼睛发光

- 微表情与眼神到位（女主锐利爆发、男主窘迫诚恳）

- 动作丝滑、运镜流畅不卡顿、无跳帧

- 无字幕、无水印、无任何标记符号、无文字

═══ CHARACTER REFS (Locked Appearance, Frame-by-Frame Consistency, No Face or Costume Changes) ═══

@ cass (Female Lead): Cassidy Marlowe, 27 years old, long layered wavy blonde hair, light hazel green eyes,

beige fitted knit dress, nude strappy high heels, gold chain necklace. Naturally warm demeanor, here turns sharply explosive.

@ marco (Male Lead): Marco Levine, 42 years old, dark curly hair with a slightly receding hairline, black-rimmed round glasses,

navy fitted suit jacket + white shirt + wool trousers + brown leather shoes. Usually confident, here becomes embarrassed and disheveled.

═══ SCENE ═══

Theater stage setting—wooden stage, dark curtain backdrop, a spotlight on the two,

audience seating hidden in darkness (blurred silhouettes and occasional reflections visible), theatrical atmosphere, with live tension.

═══ PLOT · STORYBOARD · ENGLISH DIALOGUE (Lip Sync Strictly Synchronized) ═══

SHOT 1 | 0–3 seconds | Medium Close-Up (Female Lead Facing Male Lead)

@ cass approaches @ marco step by step, chin slightly raised, eyes sharp, questioning rapidly,

each question with a rising intonation, emotions escalating:

[@ cass, questioning · escalating] "Danger? ... Danger?? ... DANGER???"

SHOT 2 | 3–4.5 seconds | Half-Body (Action Climax)

Before the words finish, @ cass delivers a theatrical backhand slap towards @ marco's face (stage performance · just enough),

@ marco's head turns aside, glasses slightly askew, the entire room falls silent.

[A loud slap sound effect]

SHOT 3 | 4.5–6 seconds | Close-Up (Female Lead)

@ cass, still fuming, forces out a curse through clenched teeth:

[@ cass, low growl] "Fuck!" (or replaced with a "beep——" censor)

SHOT 4 | 6–15 seconds | Medium Close-Up to Close-Up (Male Lead Apologizing)

@ marco adjusts his glasses, hands in a pleading gesture, expression sincerely fearful, deeply apologizes to the audience,

speaking earnestly, slightly flustered:

[@ marco, sincere apology · English]

"I'm sorry. I'm so sorry, everyone.

My whole 'danger' theory caused you all so much trouble.

I'm a stupid pig. I sincerely apologize to all of you.

We'll do everything we can to get Fable 5 online as soon as possible."

Ends with a slight bow, spotlight focusing on him.

═══ SOUND SETTINGS ═══

- @ cass: Female voice, from sharp questioning to explosive anger, breathy mixed with angry tone, rhythm staccato.

- @ marco: Male voice, sincere, urgent, slightly trembling with apology, slightly fast-paced.

- All English dialogue strictly synchronized with lip movements, clear and natural pronunciation, no lip-sync errors.

═══ VISUAL · TEXTURE ═══

Realistic live-action film texture, stage spotlight + edge contour light, warm tone, shallow depth of field,

realistic skin pores and micro-expressions, fabric physics, natural and realistic head inertia during the slap moment.

═══ CAMERA ═══

Theatrical camera positions: medium close-up / half-body / close-up switching,

quick cut + slight camera shake during the slap moment, slow push-in during the apology segment, smooth without stutter.

═══ CONSTRAINTS ═══

- 4K, landscape 16:9, approximately 15 seconds, both characters and character cards 100% consistent (no face or costume changes)

- English dialogue strictly synchronized with lip movements; dialogue sequence and emotions strictly according to the storyboard

- The slap is a stage performance · just enough, realistic head inertia but no blood or injury, not overly violent

- Realistic live-action texture, no plastic fake faces, no excessive skin smoothing, no glowing eyes

- Micro-expressions and eye contact on point (female lead sharp and explosive, male lead embarrassed and sincere)

- Smooth movements, fluid camera work without stutter, no frame skipping

- No subtitles, no watermark, no any marking symbols, no text

Claude CEO's dangerous marketing remarks deserve a big slap 👋

It's so satisfying to watch, hahaha 😂

fr.content:
═══ 角色 CHARACTER REFS（锁定形象，逐帧一致，不换脸不换装）═══

@ cass（女主）：Cassidy Marlowe, 27 ans, cheveux longs en couches, blonds légèrement ondulés, yeux vert noisette clair,

robe en tricot beige ajustée, talons hauts à fines lanières couleur chair, collier à chaîne dorée. Tempérament généralement chaleureux, ici devient tranchant et explosif.

@ marco（男主）：Marco Levine, 42 ans, cheveux foncés bouclés avec un front légèrement dégarni, lunettes rondes à monture noire,

veste de costume ajustée bleu marine + chemise blanche + pantalon en laine + chaussures en cuir marron. Habituellement confiant, ici devient embarrassé et désemparé.

═══ 场景 SCENE ═══

Scène de théâtre — scène en bois, fond de rideau sombre, un faisceau de lumière de dessus éclaire les deux personnages,

le public dans l'obscurité (silhouettes floues et quelques reflets visibles), ambiance théâtrale, tension palpable.

═══ 剧情·分镜·英文台词（口型严格同步）═══

SHOT 1｜0–3秒｜中近景（女主正对男主）

@ cass s'approche de @ marco, menton légèrement relevé, regard perçant, interroge en rafale,

chaque question avec une intonation montante, intensité émotionnelle croissante :

〔@ cass, questionnement·progression〕"Danger? ... Danger?? ... DANGER???"

SHOT 2｜3–4.5秒｜半身（动作爆点）

Avant que les mots ne se terminent, @ cass donne une gifle théâtrale à @ marco sur le côté du visage (performance scénique, sans exagération),

la tête de @ marco suit le mouvement, ses lunettes se décalent légèrement, silence total dans la salle.

〔bruit de gifle sonore〕

SHOT 3｜4.5–6秒｜面部近景（女主）

@ cass, encore en colère, laisse échapper un juron entre ses dents :

〔@ cass, grognement〕"Fuck!" (ou remplacé par un "bip——" pour le censurer)

SHOT 4｜6–15秒｜中近景转面部特写（男主道歉）

@ marco redresse ses lunettes, joint les mains en signe de prière, expression de peur respectueuse, s'excuse profondément envers le public,

parole sincère, légèrement paniquée :

〔@ marco, excuse sincère·anglais〕

"I'm sorry. I'm so sorry, everyone.

My whole 'danger' theory caused you all so much trouble.

I'm a stupid pig. I sincerely apologize to all of you.

We'll do everything we can to get Fable 5 online as soon as possible."

Il s'incline légèrement à la fin, la lumière se concentre sur lui.

═══ 声音设定 ═══

- @ cass : voix féminine, de l'acuité du questionnement à l'explosion de colère, mélange de souffle et de ton colérique, rythme saccadé.

- @ marco : voix masculine, sincère, pressée, avec une légère tremblote d'excuse, débit rapide.

- Toutes les répliques en anglais synchronisées avec les mouvements des lèvres, prononciation claire et naturelle, sans playback ni décalage.

═══ 视觉·质感 ═══

Texture réaliste de film en prise de vue réelle, lumière de dessus de scène + lumière de contour, ton chaud, faible profondeur de champ,

pores de la peau et micro-expressions réalistes, physique du tissu, inertie naturelle de la tête au moment de la gifle.

═══ 角色 CHARACTER REFS（锁定形象，逐帧一致，不换脸不换装）═══

@ cass（protagonista feminina）：Cassidy Marlowe, 27 anos, cabelo loiro longo em camadas levemente ondulado, olhos verde-avelã claros,

vestido bege justo de tricô, sandálias de salto fino cor de pele, colar de corrente dourada. Temperamento originalmente caloroso, aqui se torna afiado e explosivo.

@ marco（protagonista masculino）：Marco Levine, 42 anos, cabelo escuro cacheado com entradas, óculos redondos de armação preta,

blazer azul marinho ajustado + camisa branca + calça de lã + sapatos de couro marrom. Originalmente confiante, aqui se torna embaraçado e desajeitado.

═══ 场景 SCENE ═══

Cenário de peça teatral — palco de madeira, fundo de cortina escura, um feixe de luz superior sobre os dois,

plateia oculta na escuridão (silhuetas e reflexos esparsos visíveis), atmosfera teatral, com tensão ao vivo.

═══ 剧情·分镜·英文台词（口型严格同步）═══

SHOT 1｜0–3 segundos｜Plano médio próximo (protagonista feminina de frente para o protagonista masculino)

@ cass avança em direção a @ marco, queixo levemente erguido, olhar afiado, questionando como uma metralhadora,

cada pergunta com uma entonação crescente, emoção se intensificando:

〔@ cass, questionamento·progressivo〕"Danger? ... Danger?? ... DANGER???"

SHOT 2｜3–4.5 segundos｜Meio corpo (ponto alto da ação)

Antes que a fala termine, @ cass dá um tapa teatral no rosto de @ marco (performance teatral·sem exageros),

a cabeça de @ marco se vira, os óculos ficam tortos, silêncio total na plateia.

〔Som de um tapa alto〕

SHOT 3｜4.5–6 segundos｜Close-up (protagonista feminina)

@ cass ainda furiosa, solta um palavrão entre os dentes:

〔@ cass, rosnando〕"Fuck!" (ou um "bip——" para censurar)

SHOT 4｜6–15 segundos｜Plano médio próximo para close-up (protagonista masculino pedindo desculpas)

@ marco ajusta os óculos, faz um gesto de reverência com as mãos, expressão de medo e respeito, desculpando-se profundamente com a plateia,

fala rápida, sincera, levemente nervosa:

〔@ marco, desculpa sincera·inglês〕

"I'm sorry. I'm so sorry, everyone.

My whole 'danger' theory caused you all so much trouble.

I'm a stupid pig. I sincerely apologize to all of you.

We'll do everything we can to get Fable 5 online as soon as possible."

No final, ele faz uma leve reverência, a luz se concentra nele.

═══ 声音设定 ═══

- @ cass: Voz feminina, de questionamento afiado a explosão de raiva, mistura de ar e som de raiva, ritmo entrecortado.

- @ marco: Voz masculina, sincera, urgente, com um toque de tremor de desculpas, fala rápida.

- Todas as falas em inglês sincronizadas rigorosamente com os lábios, pronúncia clara e natural, sem dublagem ou descompasso.

═══ 视觉·质感 ═══

Qualidade de filme realista, luz superior de palco + luz de contorno, tom quente, profundidade de campo rasa,

poros da pele e microexpressões reais, física do tecido, inércia da cabeça no momento do tapa realista e natural.

═══ 镜头 CAMERA ═══

Posicionamento de câmera estilo peça teatral: plano médio próximo / meio corpo / close-up,

corte rápido no momento do tapa + leve tremor de câmera, aproximação lenta na cena de desculpas, fluido sem travamentos.

═══ CONSTRAINTS ═══

- 4K, tela horizontal 16:9, cerca de 15 segundos, dois personagens e cartões de personagem 100% consistentes (sem troca de rosto ou roupa)

- Falas em inglês sincronizadas rigorosamente com os lábios; ordem e emoção das falas rigorosamente conforme o storyboard

- Tapa como performance teatral·sem exageros, inércia da cabeça realista mas sem sangue ou ferimentos, sem violência exagerada

- Qualidade de filme realista, sem rostos de plástico, sem suavização excessiva, sem olhos brilhantes

- Microexpressões e olhares precisos (protagonista feminina afiada e explosiva, protagonista masculino embaraçado e sincero)

- Movimentos suaves, câmera fluida sem travamentos, sem frames pulados

- Sem legendas, sem marcas d'água, sem qualquer símbolo ou texto
